name: Yuri Yaan
source: Yuri is the kickboxing coach at the gym where Ian trains. Sometimes he's absent since he still goes to Thailand to train, even though he's been retired for a couple of years. However, he was a successful professional fighter, with twenty-three fights, with a record of nineteen wins and twelve knockouts
